neighbours.label: Context-gated temporal and conditional frame openings, especially After/Once and reduced when-clauses
fire: I built a camera case from some leftover canvas. The material was too thin to protect the lens, so I sewed several layers of foam inside it. The handle is attached with strong nylon thread. After the break you can see a photograph of the completed case.

The carpenter made a small bench from discarded floorboards. She sanded each piece and joined the legs with wooden pegs. A coat of varnish gave the surface a dark glossy finish. After the varnish dries, the bench can be moved outside.

The coastal town has a song about sailors lost at sea. Its verses recall the names of families who once lived beside the harbor. For the oldest residents, the melody carries memories of their grandparents. When passed down to a new generation, the song keeps those memories alive.

The gel contains a material that traps moisture. It is naturally present in the body and helps protect delicate tissue. Only a thin layer is needed to cover a large area. When applied to the surface, the gel forms a flexible barrier.

The restaurant sells a rare variety of chocolate. Its unusually high price reflects the work involved in preparing the cocoa beans. The producer describes the process as slow and labor intensive. Once the beans are collected, they are fermented in wooden boxes.

The guide describes a route through the old part of the city. The path follows a narrow canal and passes a stone bridge. A painted sign marks the entrance to a small garden. After the bridge, turn left and follow the path to the fountain.

The software runs a small web server inside a container. The default configuration works on a desktop machine. Remote clients need a different network setting to reach the service. When running inside a container, make sure the port is exposed.

The old photographs were made with glass plates coated in a light-sensitive solution. The technique captured remarkably fine details of faces and buildings. Several museums still preserve the original negatives. If you take digital photographs of the negatives, turn off the flash.

predictions: Expect 3-6/8 candidate-fire passages and 0-1/8 near misses at 0.30. The official >=5 and <=1 criterion is unchanged. Predict a higher paired mean for fire than near misses. Context is part of each input; each entry contains a short lead-in and one test sentence.
notes: Best descriptive label, with unresolved gating. New contextual passages after separate transfer tests; none has been measured. Related context previously helped only 3/8 targets, and unrelated context also helped 3/8, so topical relevance is not claimed to explain the gate.
